matrix.branchMeaning: Named launch branches and distinct dispatch/reuse/refusal controls, not a count of unique spawn call sites

controls.oracle: Each named branch carries owner, captured env, profile tiers, admission, deadline/signal and receipt to the actual producer and consumer; constructor-only or unread fields fail.

Canonical and configured credential sentinels are absent after override merge; ordinary project vars and PATH survive; inheritance off is replacement; later ambient mutation cannot alter approved retry env.
An explicit synthetic delegated credential reaches only its intended trusted MCP destination; all other children strip it; upstream transport default-env merge is observed rather than assumed absent.

Missing required authorizer, denied, unavailable required profile, pre-aborted signal, expired deadline and abort during delayed approval each cause zero target/probe/discovery launches. Explicit allow-all remains allowed.
Requested, available, active and enforced are separate; deliberate full access is reported as full access; optional degradation is explicit; lexical permission labels cannot become OS enforcement.

Omitted and false inference are disabled; true enables inference; configured origin/trust/profile and authorizer outcomes survive; actual timeout/default matches documented selection and tighter parent budget.
Probes, target and retries consume one remaining parent budget; omitted limits remain explicitly unbounded; sync callers declare or resolve unavailable cancellation rather than ignore a signal.

Compatible reusable LSP/MCP/probe resources retain resource owner and request leases; incompatible env/profile context cannot reuse stale resources; caller cancellation is distinct from resource cancellation.

A trusted self-contained strategy independently chooses and performs read/edit/terminal through real SDK under full access; a required unavailable profile refuses before the affected target launch; action/run evidence reaches the consumer.
Explicit selected user/model/agent route remains selected with conflicting recommendation; lifecycle context does not prescribe the strategy next task action.

Capture setup clone/fetch/checkout/init, isolated SDK worker, final check and post-run Git add/diff. Preserve typed B30 output and environment-only scope; bind actual env/owner/admission/remaining budget at each launch.

Hold a child across parent return; retain original root/action identity and resource owner/lease. Explicit shell detach records receiving owner/deadline; background agent parent-linked abort remains distinguishable. Parent return never proves cleanup.
Before acceptance rebind changed sources, fixture roster, consumer outputs and independent review; preparation and pre-B19 CI do not constitute B19 acceptance.
